description: Set a tracked competitor's other names and sites, so answers that use them count for it: aliases (other names, such as a former or a product name) and extraSites (other domains it runs). Each list you send replaces that list; a list you leave out stays. Up to 20 each. Removing a name or a site waits for the workspace owner to approve it in RankControl; the answer is then an approval link.
name: update_competitor
